decision.explanation: The term 'Turkish Republican Party' can refer to multiple entities. The Republican People's Party (CHP), often considered the founding party of the Turkish Republic, was established in 1923. The Republican Turkish Party (CTP) in Northern Cyprus was founded in 1970. Additionally, another Republican Party in Turkey was founded on 4 September 1972.
